reviews.text:
I had such a wonderful experience here! Everyone was so kind and provided such amazing service. I explained beforehand that I was nervous because it was my cat’s first time being groomed, and she’s a very anxious cat. They handled her SO well and made sure she was comfortable and safe throughout the entire experience. When they told me she did great, it honestly meant so much to me because I could tell they had taken the time to make her feel safe and cared for.

The grooming itself was also amazing! Before her appointment, they reviewed all of the services with me, and since this was my first time, I had so many questions. They answered every single one patiently and were genuinely happy to help.

I’m so happy I found this place and will absolutely be going back. I highly recommend them, especially if you have an anxious or nervous pet!

I recently moved to neighborhood and needed a groomer for my dog urgently. They were super easy to schedule, without waiting for 2 weeks like it’s usual thing with pet groomers. They did amazing job! Seems like my dog was happy too! I’ll definitely come back 😊

Uptown Salon is great! Been bringing my dog here for about a year now. They are very friendly and she is less afraid to go here than Ravenswoof. Pricing is pretty comparable to other places in the area. Best thing is they almost always have openings within about a week, so no need to book months in advance like other places. Highly recommend!
Love Uptown Pet Grooming! They do an amazing job grooming my husky, Lulu. She barely sheds after. Miracle workers!

I took my lab mix here after realizing I could no longer handle the shedding situation at home. Fur was literally collecting in corners no matter how much I vacuumed. The groomer recommended a deep brush-out treatment and spent extra time on his undercoat instead of rushing through it. When I picked him up, his coat looked healthier and there was barely any loose hair coming off during the drive home. He also smelled clean without that heavy perfume scent that usually bothers me.
We took our two dogs in for a walk in nail trim, and they did such a great job for a great price. Absolutely recommend.

Uptown Pet Salon has been a constant since I got my pup 3 years ago.  She is a very anxious cockapoo and I have always been nervous dropping her off to get groomed because of that. They have always done such a fantastic job with her-they are quick, yet thorough, affordable and treat my dog, Daisy, so well. They do so well with her that I have peace of mind when I drop her off. Very grateful for them!
Great customer service. Great groomers!
Really bad attitude with the people working there won't even try to make the grooming u want
I've seen videos on social media of one of the groomers a d based on how she works with senior dogs, lacking compassion, and patience i would never bring my pets here. Do better.

I can’t say enough good things about Uptown Pet Salon! They truly take such great care of my dog, Bluebell, and treat him with patience and professionalism. Bluebell is very energetic, doesn’t like being in a crate, and even knows how to open them—at our previous groomer we would always get complaints about him being “naughty” or “difficult.”

But at Uptown Pet Salon, the experience has been completely different. The staff reassured me that they had no problem with Bluebell at all, and it shows in the way he comes home happy and well-groomed every single time. We’ve been going here for almost 3 years now, and I’m so glad we made the switch. It’s such a relief to know he’s in good hands with people who understand and care about dogs as individuals. Highly recommend!
Clean quick and friendly,  they do a wonderful job, and reasonable price, ive been taking my 2 shitzus there for 3 years

I am a big fan of Uptown Pet Salon! My dog is a wheaten terrier that is anxious and challenging at the groomer. They handle him with ease here, being patient, kind, and efficient. I’ve gone here twice already and each time he returns with a fantastic haircut and seems very happy.

I've been here many times. I used to take cats for shearing and bathing. It's my first time to take dogs for shearing. As a result, I was very satisfied, and my family especially liked their work. Although it's half an hour away from my home, I still want to come. I like their work very much.I highly recommend it.
I was very pleased with the service. No appointment. I took my 8 month old chihuahua for nail clippings  and I was in and out within 10 minutes and the price was affordable as well.

I called in advance for a nail trim and they were so accommodating!!! I asked if they had specific nail trim hours or needed an appointment and they said just come in. My situation is quite different as I have 2 medical fosters that are in hospice care and can't stand. Everyone has turned me down with all sorts of excuses, so I thought going in person maybe someone would be kind enough to help. That person was Maria!!! Omg!!! Animal lover and true advocate so right there she had me!!! A dog whisperer because I have one able bodied 10 y.o., chihuahua former medical foster that is a fear biter which I kept for that reason.  He has a hideous reputation in his  30 page medical records, so I am forced to pay at vet to trim so that no person is harmed!!! Maria said let me take him and I was worried, not gonna lie!!! He is a screamer and nothing!!! The best nail trim he has had as vet tech would piss me off claiming one or two nails were too close to nail bed so should come every two weeks which is $65 a pop! She must be magical because not one of my animals had a nick to nail bed!!! And she was willing to help with my sick animals wish I knew about them sooner!!! I had gone to Laura at Jameson because it was a block from where I lived but sadly, the lease went up and lost her help. I can't thank them enough!!! The fear biter couldn't even be trimmed at Jameson they tried so Maria has something special about her aura for real!!!

Uptown Pet Salon has great availability, super fair pricing, and Maria always does a beautiful job on our sweet dog, Ted. We are so appreciative of the care she takes and we always feel great leaving him in her capable hands!

They take you in last minute. Overall do a good job and friendly. 4 stars because they have left my dog choppy a couple times and it didn’t look great. Especially since my dog loves getting groomed and doesn’t give them a hassle at all.

They were great with my reactive dog. He's a little monster and he needed an emergency groom, and uptown pet salon was able to fit him in on short notice and get him cleaned up. I couldn't believe how fluffy and soft he is.
Been taking my shitzu here since 2021! Love this place!

I'm not sure who the owner is, but the woman pretending to be the owner is disgustingly ignorant and rude. She claimed to be the owner, but I can't imagine being so horrid. If you care about your pet at all, DO NOT take them here. The place is so dirty, they have no pride in their own business.

Edit: I don't know why you're lying. I said a simple apology or acknowledgment would have sufficed. It's really sad that you have to lie because the truth makes you look bad.
Don't take your pets here! After Maria cut my dog's nails too short to the point of bleeding, she would not take accountability and was even extremely rude and not apologetic at all. She blamed my husky for being too playful that she was bleeding from her nail. She even told me, "She's not going to die."

They cut the quick of my dogs nail. When I called them to see if they had really cut it, they were very rude and blamed my dog saying that she could caused it to bleed herself when you can clearly see that the nail was cut using a dog nail clipper. Also we suspect that my dog may have been given a sedative as she was very tired and inactive which is very uncharacteristic of a husky.
Thanks for always making my pup look fabulous!

We picked up our dogs two days ago and we’re very disappointed with the result. I’m not sure if there’s new people there, but we had been going there previously and we were always quite happy with the result. With a positive history, we thought we would see the same when we picked our dogs this past Monday. When we picked up our dogs, one of them was noticeably in pain from his nose being shaved way too close to the eyes that he couldn’t open either of them. We were told that was because he had eye boogers. If you work with dogs the expectation is you know how to clean-wash a dog’s eyes / nose area. For the record, we clean our dogs’s faces all the time. That was not the case and we will not be returning.

Never going back. Just picked up my dog and after we paid they bring out my dog and his eyes are extremely irritated and red. He will not even open his eyes. I’ve never had this experience before. I just flushed them with saline. The haircuts look ugly as hell too.
Excellent service, I have been taking my dog for four years now and they always treat him with love. And the service is amazing!!!

very poor customer service and accommodation for anxious dogs, especially for bull terrier owners. The groomer says that she works with aggressive dogs, but apparently this time she’s never dealt with a dog like mine before she said my dog was way too aggressive and she couldn’t even cut her nails even with a muzzle on. I understand not wanting to risk getting hurt but at the same time they should find ways to accommodate for anxious dogs and not just turn them down right away. I wish this space could do a better job at accommodating dogs like mine and creating more friendly environments so that dogs aren’t walking in scared and anxious. They’re all there safe space for dogs that don’t require cages and there are workers that are willing to work with dogs like mine to ensure that they are properly groomed and are healthy. Very sad to experience something like this. Don’t think I’d ever come back again.

Uptown Pet Salon has been our go to groomer for the past 3 yrs. Our dog Zelda is terrified of nail trims and baths and they have done such an incredible job getting to know her and now she is no fuss at all when we drop her off and she is smiling and beautiful when we pick her up. Everyone on staff is so sweet and loving to the dogs. I am also usually able to get same week appointments and the cost is so much better than similar places. Can’t recommend them enough!
This place is the best, I've been taking my Petra here for many years
They take such great care of my cats and we always get compliments on their cuts!
Great price and great job at washing my stinky lil dog!

Been going here for probably 5-7 years. This place is amazing and my dogs love them and they are super super crazy dogs but the owners/groomers just laugh and say they are well behaved and tell me they are adorable 😂. True dog lovers. …
